account.registerPlaceholder: What would you like to be called?

general.generateAudioHelp: When disabled, text replies remain visible but speech synthesis is skipped.
general.maxHistoryTurnsHelp: Number of completed user-assistant turns included as context in each model request. The current message is added separately. Range: 1-100; default: 8.
general.debugModeHelp: When enabled, chats are still saved, but rolling, long-term memory, long-term relationship, and short-term relationship summaries are disabled. These conversations will not be summarized later after debug mode is disabled.

tts.customBgUrl: Or enter a custom background URL
tts.imageCompressionQualityHelp: JPEG compression quality (0.1-1.0). Default is 0.8 to reduce file size when transmitting images to AI models, as we don't compress images during API transmission which could result in large file sizes.
tts.imageMaxWidthHelp: Maximum width for image resizing. Images exceeding this width will be proportionally scaled down. Set to 0 for no size limit. This feature exists because some AI models may have limitations when processing very large images. However, most AI models can handle images automatically, so the default is 0 (no restriction) to preserve your original images.

key.grokEnabledHelp: When enabled, only interactive model chat uses Grok. Long-term memory, long-term relationship, short-term relationship, and rolling summaries continue to use DeepSeek. This switch turns off after a page reload or a new page session.

asr.autoStopMic: Auto Stop Mic When AI Start Speaking
asr.autoStopMicDesc: Automatically stops microphone when AI begins speaking to prevent audio feedback
asr.autoStartMicOnConvEnd: Auto Start Mic When Conversation End
asr.autoStartMicOnConvEndDesc: Automatically restarts microphone when AI finishes speaking for seamless conversation
asr.autoStartMicOn: Auto Start Mic When AI Interrupted
asr.autoStartMicOnDesc: Automatically restarts microphone when you interrupt AI for continuous interaction
asr.positiveSpeechThresholdDesc: Minimum confidence level (1-100) required to detect speech. Higher values reduce false positives
asr.negativeSpeechThresholdDesc: Confidence level (0-100) below which speech detection stops. Lower values make detection less sensitive
asr.redemptionFramesDesc: Number of consecutive frames (1-100) needed to confirm speech detection. Higher values reduce noise triggers

agent.idleSecondsToSpeak: Idle seconds allow AI to speak
agent.allowButtonTrigger: Prompt AI to Speak via Raise Hand Button
